source_full: I should like some of the cats gold for myself she thought, as she left her mother's house before the sun rose. The cat colony had not yet taken another servant, for they knew they could never get one to replace Lizina, Whose loss they had not yet ceased to mourn. When they heard that Peppina was her sister, They all ran to meet her.
